All clean now! The build completes successfully with exit code 0. Here's what I fixed:

**Two API mismatches from the dependency bump:**

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — The new bundler changed the options shape from `retries` to `retryCount`. Updated the function to use the new property name.

2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Added a check to treat `undefined` as `false` for the backoff flag.

The remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation notices from the bundler's own internal dependencies—nothing that needs fixing in your code. Build's ready to go!
